name: Vine Blight

actions.name: Constrict
actions.effect: Target is grappled. Grappled targets take 1d6 bludgeoning at the start of each of the Vine Blight's turns.

actions.name: Entangling Plants
actions.effect: All creatures on the ground within 5m of the Vine Blight must pass PHYS save or be restrained by grasping vines. Restrained targets can attempt a PHYS save at end of each turn to escape.

reactions.name: Vine Lash
reactions.effect: When a creature enters melee range, the Vine Blight lashes out. Target must pass PHYS save or be grappled.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While motionless, the Vine Blight is indistinguishable from a tangle of vines.

lore: Vine Blights are masses of creeping vines animated by dark magic. They specialize in area control, entangling everything around them in a suffocating web of vegetation. They often work in concert with Twig and Needle Blights.
